evidence: X-ray diﬀraction (XRD), secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) and photoluminescence (PL) were used to characterize the strained quantum wells. The composition was determined from the measurement of the X-ray diﬀraction, and the layer thickness was measured by scanning electron microscopy (SEM), surface proﬁling (Dektak 3030ST) and ellipsometry. Secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS) measurements were carried out to analyze the ZnSe/ZnS SMQW depth profile.
